'''Freesia''' (Japanese: '''フリージア''' ''Freesia'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. She made her main appearance in ''[[DP171|Dawn of a Royal Day!]]''.

Freesia is one of the people who works for [[Princess Salvia]], who she appears to have a close friendship with. She confronted {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} outside of the [[Arrowroot Town]] [[Contest Hall]], when {{an|Brock}} suddenly began to flirt with her. After [[Brock's Croagunk]] {{m|Poison Jab|attacked}} him, Freesia asked {{an|Dawn}} to help the princess by switching places. After they did so, she stayed by Dawn's side to advise her throughout the required royal duties.

Freesia made a brief cameo in ''[[DP177|A Grand Fight For Winning!]]'', where she, along with Salvia, was seen watching the [[Contest Battle]] between [[Zoey]] and Dawn in the final round of the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]].
